Lam. R. to II, 13 בערביא וכ׳ in Arabia they call spoil (ביזתא) ăditha (with ref. to אעידך ib.). Cmp. עֲדוּדָה. [Targ. Is. LX, 16 (h. text שׁד̇); v. preced. w.]—Trnsf. בִּיזְתָא robbed woman.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:15">Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 2</cite> <he>הא ב׳ עלובתא</he> this poor robbed woman; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 750:2">Yalk. Num. 750</cite> (incorr. vers.).
